contexts.claim_boundary: E2 computational pose-localization result within the bounded cognate redocking benchmark envelope; not universal validation.

limitations: validated only within the declared cognate benchmark envelope
does not establish affinity, potency, efficacy, or experimental pose truth

contexts.claim_boundary: E2 computational cross-docking result with partial bounded validation and reduced robustness relative to cognate redocking.
contexts.description: Non-cognate holo receptor conformation of the same target family, known pocket, rigid receptor, and same-frame pose localization.
limitations: rank-1 and any-pose observations are distinct endpoints
not validated for apo, blind, induced-fit, affinity, biological, or clinical claims

contexts.claim_boundary: Exploratory E2 computational result only; the evaluated evidence does not support a reliable pose-recovery claim for rigid apo docking.
contexts.description: Prospective ligand docking into a rigid apo receptor at a known site under the APODOCK protocols.
limitations: no demonstrated <=2.0 angstrom pose recovery in the evaluated determinate cases
execution and analysis indeterminates are preserved
APODOCK v1.2 is not scientifically justified by current evidence

contexts.claim_boundary: No validated docking capability claim may be elevated from an unknown context; retain an explicit out-of-domain limitation.

limitations: context must be declared and supported before a bounded capability claim is made

interpretation_boundaries.prohibition: docking score is not measured binding affinity, potency, or free energy
docking success is not efficacy, safety, therapeutic activity, or clinical evidence
a predicted docking pose is not experimental structural truth
one benchmark cannot establish general validation outside its frozen envelope
computational docking evidence remains E2_COMPUTATIONAL regardless of benchmark outcome

known_failure_modes.description: A returned pose cannot be converted into the declared analysis representation.
The frozen reference lacks a complete permitted heavy-atom correspondence.
A declared preparation or docking subprocess exceeds its immutable timeout.
The docking engine does not produce a valid completed case result.
Pose 1 exceeds the frozen same-frame localization threshold.
A near-native pose is present in the returned set but is not ranked first.
No returned pose reaches the frozen localization threshold.
The receptor conformation differs from the context supported by the evidence.
A representation adapter produces unstable or non-reproducible derived artifacts.
Derived SDF bytes differ despite identical scientific metrics; preserve raw outputs and record the limitation.

profile_scope: bounded computational workflow behavior under frozen docking protocols; not affinity, potency, efficacy, or experimental truth
